title: Making textile color without chemicals – level 1
paragraphs: Making clothes uses many bad chemicals. They hurt our oceans and rivers. Companies are looking for better ways which do not hurt nature.

A new company makes clean colors for clothes with the help of bacteria. They grow the colors in big tanks, similar to making beer. This green method uses much less water, energy, and electricity than old methods. The new colors are safe for human skin and do not wash away easily in water. Big clothing brands are starting to buy these natural dyes today. The company wants to stop using toxic chemicals because nature can make every bright color safely.
